core_obligations: Since X is quasi-compact, all five statements are local; assume E represented by a bounded complex E-bullet of finite free modules.
Parts (1): the cohomology sheaves of a bounded finite-free complex are coherent, so E in D^b_Coh.

Parts (2)-(5): tensor and internal Hom are computed at the complex level by the two named lemmas; the entries of E-bullet tensor L-bullet and R Hom(E-bullet, L-bullet) are finite sums of coherent modules, and boundedness of the result follows from the boundedness of the inputs in each of the four boundedness cases.
Carry the degree bookkeeping for each of (2)-(5) explicitly (unbounded, bounded, bounded below, bounded above).
proof_roadmap: Affine-local reduction; finite-free representative; complex-level tensor and Hom; boundedness bookkeeping per case.
difficulty_reason: A five-part closure statement reduced to one finite-free computation with per-part bookkeeping.
